# Learn Thai with Flashcards

> A free Thai vocabulary course with 460 lessons, 4,778 words and 640 example sentences. Words are shown in Thai script with romanization and an English meaning, many have audio, and each lesson can be studied as flashcards or a quiz. No sign-up.

## Start here

- [How the course works](https://thai.inaflash.cards/start/): what it is, how a lesson works, where to begin
- [Questions and connections](https://thai.inaflash.cards/01-questions-and-connections/): the first lesson
- [All lessons](https://thai.inaflash.cards/lessons/): every lesson, searchable
